fn sqlescape (s)
    buf := StringBuffer
    for c in s
        if (c == 39) buf .. "''"
        elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
        elseif (c == 0) buf .. "\\0"
        elseif (c == 10) buf .. "\\n"
        elseif (c == 13) buf .. "\\r"
        elseif (c == 26) buf .. "\\Z"
        elseif (c == 34) buf .. "\\\""
        else buf .. (tostring c)
    buf as String

fn sha1raw (s)
    ctx := SHA_CTX
    SHA1_Init &ctx
    SHA1_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 20)
    SHA1_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    digest

fn mysqlscramble (pwd scramble)
    p1 := sha1raw pwd
    p2 := sha1raw (p1 as String)
    p3 := sha1raw ((scramble as String) .. (p2 as String))
    out := (array i8 20)
    for i in (range 20)
        out @ i = ((p1 @ i) as i8) ^ ((p3 @ i) as i8)
    out

fn stringtrim (s)
    i := 0
    j := (countof s)
    while (i < j) and (((s @ i) == 32) or ((s @ i) == 9) or ((s @ i) == 10) or ((s @ i) == 13))
        i += 1
    while (j > i) and (((s @ (j  1)) == 32) or ((s @ (j  1)) == 9) or ((s @ (j  1)) == 10) or ((s @ (j  1)) == 13))
        j = 1
    s slice i j

fn splitstring (s delim)
    out := (Array)
    start := 0
    dlen := (countof delim)
    loop (i)
        if (i >= (countof s))
            'append out (s slice start (countof s))
            break out
        if ((i + dlen <= (countof s)) and ((s slice i (i + dlen)) == delim))
            'append out (s slice start i)
            start := i + dlen
            i + dlen
        else
            i + 1

fn sha512hex (s)
    ctx := SHA512_CTX
    SHA512_Init &ctx
    SHA512_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 64)
    SHA512_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    buf := StringBuffer
    for i in (range 64)
        val := (digest @ i) as u8
        hi := (val >> 4) & 0xF
        lo := val & 0xF
        buf .. (if (hi < 10) (tostring (hi + 48)) (tostring (hi  10 + 65)))
        buf .. (if (lo < 10) (tostring (lo + 48)) (tostring (lo  10 + 65)))
    buf as String

fn buildjson (val)
    switch (typeof val)
    case String
        s := val as String
        buf := StringBuffer
        buf .. "\""
        for c in s
            if (c == 34) buf .. "\\\""
            elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
            elseif (c == 10) buf .. "\\n"
            elseif (c == 13) buf .. "\\r"
            elseif (c == 9) buf .. "\\t"
            else buf .. (tostring c)
        buf .. "\""
        buf as String
    case boolean
        if (val as boolean) "true" else "false"
    case integer
        tostring (val as integer)
    case real
        tostring (val as real)
    case null
        "null"
    case table
        buf := "{"
        first := true
        for k v in (val as table)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= buildjson k
            buf ..= ":"
            buf ..= buildjson v
        buf .. "}"
    case array
        buf := "["
        first := true
        for v in (val as array)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= buildjson v
        buf .. "]"
    default
        "null"

fn jsonparseskipws (s idx)
    while (idx < (countof s))
        c := s @ idx
        if (c != 32) and (c != 9) and (c != 10) and (c != 13)
            break
        idx + 1

fn jsonparsestring (s idx)
    if ((s @ idx) != 34) return ('null null) idx
    idx += 1
    buf := StringBuffer
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('string (buf as String)) idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c == 34) break ('string (buf as String)) (idx + 1)
        if (c == 92)
            if (idx + 1 < (countof s))
                n := s @ (idx + 1)
                if (n == 110) buf ..= "\n"
                elseif (n == 114) buf ..= "\r"
                elseif (n == 116) buf ..= "\t"
                elseif (n == 34) buf ..= '"'
                elseif (n == 92) buf ..= "\\"
                else buf ..= (tostring n)
                idx := idx + 2
            else idx + 1
        else
            buf ..= (tostring c)
            idx + 1

fn jsonparsenumber (s idx)
    start := idx
    isfloat := false
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c >= 48) and (c <= 57) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 45) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 46) isfloat := true; idx + 1
        elseif (c == 69) or (c == 101) isfloat := true; idx + 1
        else break idx
    str := s slice start idx
    if isfloat ('real (atof (str as rawstring))) idx
    else ('integer (atoi (str as rawstring))) idx

fn jsonparsevalue (s idx)
    idx := jsonparseskipws s idx
    if (idx >= (countof s)) return ('null null) idx
    c := s @ idx
    if (c == 34) jsonparsestring s idx
    elseif (c == 123)
        idx += 1
        obj := (table)
        loop (idx)
            idx := jsonparseskipws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 125) break ('table obj) (idx + 1)
            key kidx := jsonparsevalue s idx
            idx := jsonparseskipws s kidx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 58) idx := jsonparseskipws s (idx + 1)
            val vidx := jsonparsevalue s idx
            idx := vidx
            if ((typeof key) == String) obj @ (key as String) = val
            idx := jsonparseskipws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44) idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 91)
        idx += 1
        arr := (Array)
        loop (idx)
            idx := jsonparseskipws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('array arr) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 93) break ('array arr) (idx + 1)
            val vidx := jsonparsevalue s idx
            idx := vidx
            'append arr val
            idx := jsonparseskipws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44) idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 116) if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "true") ('boolean true) (idx + 4) else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 102) if ((s slice idx (idx + 5)) == "false") ('boolean false) (idx + 5) else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 110) if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "null") ('null null) (idx + 4) else ('null null) idx
    else jsonparsenumber s idx

fn parsejson (s)
    val idx := jsonparsevalue s 0
    val

fn redisconnectsingle (host port)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return 1
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return 1
    fd

fn mysqlconnectsingle (host port user pwd db)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return 1

    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host

        close fd
        return 1
    
    header := (array i8 4)
    if ((recv fd (header as rawstring) 4 0) != 4)
        close fd
        return 1
    len := (header @ 0) as i32 | ((header @ 1) as i32 << 8) | ((header @ 2) as i32 << 16)
    pkt := (array i8 (len + 10))
    pkt @ 0 = (header @ 3)
    if ((recv fd ((pkt as rawstring) + 1) len 0) != len)
        close fd
        return 1
    
    scramble := ""
    if (len > 10)
        s1 := (pkt slice 5 13)
        if (len > 36)
            s2 := (pkt slice 28 40)
            scramble = (s1 as String) .. (s2 as String)
        else scramble = s1 as String
    
    resppkt := StringBuffer
    cap := 157403712
    resppkt .. (tostring (cap & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 8) & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 16) & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 24) & 0xFF))
    resppkt .. "\x00\x00\x00\x01" .. "\x21" .. ((array i8 23) as String) .. user .. "\x00"
    sc := mysqlscramble pwd scramble
    resppkt .. (tostring (countof sc)) .. (sc as String) .. db .. "\x00"
    
    finalpkt := (array i8 4)
    rlen := countof resppkt
    finalpkt @ 0 = (rlen & 0xFF) as i8
    finalpkt @ 1 = ((rlen >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    finalpkt @ 2 = ((rlen >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    finalpkt @ 3 = 1
    if ((send fd (finalpkt as rawstring) 4 0) != 4)
        close fd
        return 1
    if ((send fd ((resppkt as String) as rawstring) rlen 0) != rlen)
        close fd
        return 1
    
    recv fd (array i8 256) 256 0
    fd

fn curlsocketcallback (easy sock what userp multi)
    action := 0
    if ((what & CURL_POLL_IN) != 0) action |= EPOLLIN
    if ((what & CURL_POLL_OUT) != 0) action |= EPOLLOUT
    
    ev := epoll_event
    ev.events = action as u32
    ev.data.fd = sock
    
    epfd := userp as i32
    if (what != CURL_POLL_NONE)
        if (('key? clients sock)) 
            epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_MOD sock ev
        else
            epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD sock ev
    else
        epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_DEL sock null

A connection pooling drasztikusan csökkenti a latenciát azáltal, hogy elkerüli az új TCP kapcsolatok és autentikációs folyamatok költségeit minden egyes kérésnél.[4]

epfd := epoll_create1 0

 10. SQL Injection Védelem

A kód implementál egy sql-escape függvényt:[16]


fn sql-escape (s)
    buf := StringBuffer
    for c in s
        if (c == 39) buf .. "''"
        elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
        elseif (c == 0) buf .. "\\0"


Védett karakterek:
 ' (single quote) → ''
 \ (backslash) → \\
 \0 (null byte) → \0
 \n (newline) → \n
 \r (carriage return) → \r
 \Z (EOF) → \Z
 " (double quote) → \"

Ez védelmet nyújt SQL injection támadások ellen, bár modern gyakorlat szerint prepared statementek használata ajánlottabb lenne.

 15. Nonblocking I/O és Buffer Management

A szerver minden socketet nonblocking módba állít:[7]


flags := fcntl cfd F_GETFL 0
fcntl cfd F_SETFL (flags | O_NONBLOCK)


Buffer struktúra minden klienshez:
 read-buf: Bejövő HTTP kérések
 write-buf: Kimenő HTTP válaszok
 stream-buf: AI streaming buffer
 exa-buffer: Web search eredmények

Chunkwise sending:

if ((ev.events & EPOLLOUT) != 0) and ((countof client.write-buf) > 0)
    n := send fd (client.write-buf as rawstring) (countof client.write-buf) 0
    if (n > 0)
        client.write-buf = ((client.write-buf as String) slice n)


Ez lehetővé teszi a backpressure kezelését  ha a kliens nem tudja elég gyorsan fogadni az adatokat, a szerver buffereli azokat és folytatja más kliensek kiszolgálását.
